findings.fix: Add method="post" to the form element.
findings.violation: The form defaults to GET method, which sends form data as URL parameters. This creates a security vulnerability where the password and other sensitive fields would appear in the URL and browser history.

findings.fix: Add pattern="[0-9]{8}" or minlength="8" maxlength="8" to the input element.
findings.violation: The input has no pattern validation, minlength, or maxlength to enforce the stated 8-digit requirement.

findings.evidence: `<select id="shipspeed-select" required="">` with no name attribute
findings.fix: Add name="shipping_speed" (or similar) to the select element.
findings.violation: The select element is missing the name attribute, so this field's value will not be submitted with the form data.

findings.fix: Change the label to "Legal name" to match the field name and clarify the distinction from the full name field.
findings.violation: The label says "Your name" but there's already a "Full name" field earlier, making it unclear which field is which.

findings.fix: Remove the style attribute and define label styling in a CSS stylesheet instead.
findings.violation: The inline style="display:block" is unnecessary and redundant, as labels are already block-level elements. Styling should be in a stylesheet.
Uses type="text" for a time preference field, which doesn't provide appropriate input semantics or user controls.

findings.fix: Either add an onclick handler to implement the intended functionality or remove the button if it is not needed.
findings.violation: The button has no onclick handler or apparent purpose, making it unclear what action it performs.
